The '''Cascade of Rrynorrorun''' was presumably a body of flowing water and was found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] compared the traffic on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to it, saying both were endless and calming.
